newsitem.title: USA: Great Western to settle Fla. suit - lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Great Western to settle Fla. suit - lawyers.

text.p: Great Western Bank has agreed to pay a group of Florida investors $6 million to settle a class-action lawsuit, lawyers for the plaintiffs said on Friday.

The suit charged the bank, a unit of Great Western Financial Corp, misled investors into buying mutual funds by saying the funds would provide much higher yields than maturing certificates of deposits, the lawyers said in a statement.
"We believe this is an excellent settlement which should return 100 percent of all losses of principal suffered by the Florida investors," said attorney Alvin Lodish.
A spokeswoman for Great Western said she was unable to confirm the report of the settlement.
Later, Laura Snow, Great Western's vice president of public relations, said the company and the plaintiff reached an agreement and submitted a draft for court approval.
"Great Western is certainly pleased that these lawsuits are on their way toward resolution. A settlement will bring this time-consuming and costly lawsuit to an end," Snow said.
The settlement does not represent an admission of wrongdoing, Snow added.
